high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation titled "Our Work on Brain Algorithms." The slide has a clean, professional design with a white background and black text. At the top, the title is prominently displayed in orange and black fonts. The content of the slide is divided into two main bullet points: Goal: Understand how computation is performed in biological neural networks, in terms of distributed algorithms. Biological features we consider: Spiking neurons, noisy firing thresholds, excitation and inhibition, restricted connectivity, synapse weights, synchronization.
